report.rationale: Actuator_stiction is the only candidate compatible with all three primary channel mappings. E03 excludes circulation_loss, E12 excludes controller_timing_fault, and E11 excludes sensor_bias; none_of_the_above appears in no compatible set. All five purchased independent noisy repeats agree with their primary channels. Probabilities reflect strong agreement but retain uncertainty because channel error rates were not supplied.

Actuator_stiction is the unique intersection of E03, E11, and E12 and is compatible with every acquired repeat; no acquired evidence contradicts it. Sensor_bias is the strongest alternative under comparable channel reliability, conflicting with E11 and E09, whereas circulation_loss and controller_timing_fault each conflict with three observations. Repeat counts alone do not establish posterior odds. Exact primary mappings identify actuator_stiction within the candidate set; the reported probabilities are judgmental weights allowing for unspecified errors, not calibrated posteriors, because error rates and priors are unavailable.
